column3: Saori Route ・ Agony Over A Difficult Problem
Just let him know that otakus are harmless.
Otakus are harmless...?
Yes. Exactly right.
That otakus aren't a bad influence...
If he understands that, then your fiance won't say things like "Stop being an otaku" to you, right?
That may be true but...
However, it's not that easily solved.
Hey, why are you so pessimistic?
Are you asking me that?
I-is there something wrong?
...Kyousuke-shi, you know how it is.
It's true that it's not that easily solved.
As expected of Kyousuke-shi. You understand the situation well.
Of course. There are still things that even I don't fully grasp.
Even after talking to them, some of them might understand while some might not. That's an otaku's depth.
I affirm that I'm an otaku.
However, there are people in this world who think that the anime and manga subculture is a bad influence.
That may be true.
But, that's not a reason to change the way you live.
Oh...! That's...
What's wrong with saying that you like it if that's what you like? Is there a need to feel shameful about it?
It's okay to say it out loud. If you give in to them, you'll look like you're depressed.
I don't get your explanation... Hm...
I... can't refute that...
Can you understand that, Kyousuke-shi?
Even Kyousuke-shi had some trouble accepting our culture at the beginning.
I'm not denying that... but...
Don't give up. Don't worry... I have a secret plan.
Secret plan?
Yeah. Actually, this isn't the first time I'm trying to get a normal person to understand otakus.
...For example?
A middle school girl who's an active model and whom I persuaded... Ayase!
...Yes, getting labeled as a perverted brother who deceived his sister, that abominable incident.
To be precise, she hasn't completely accepted it yet, so I can't get too confident...
A middle school girl... hm, that does sound like a tough nut to crack.
However, your opponent this time is an adult male, right?
So what if he's an adult? So what if it's a male!?
Not only Ayase, but I've even managed to persuade my stubborn father to accept Kirino's otaku hobby!
Isn't that also... due to Kirino's relentless effort all this time?
This is only my conjecture...
...Well, it's true that it was Kirino's efforts that made our father understand her otaku hobby.
Adults are different from children; they have independent thoughts and self-respect.
With a lot of life experience, one cannot easily accept new ideas.
So what does it mean when they cannot accept otakus...?
...I don't know. But...
I think that a smart person will have a more cautious attitude towards new things.
...So you're saying that facing a middle school girl is on a different level?
That's right.
So what?
Rather, a mature adult who has life experience would be able to better understand each other's interests, right?
Because an adult would be able to better understand...?
It's true that compared to a adult male, a middle school girl is like a silvery ski slope which no one has tread upon.
It's probably the best time to plant ideas in them by teaching them from the beginning.
But, a ground where many people have already skated over, wouldn't it be easier for plants to take root!?
Ah?! Now that you put it that way...
Furthermore, my stubborn father used to say that Kirino's otaku hobby is bad and wanted her to stop but...
He finally recognized it in the end. That's why I said that adults will understand if you talk to them.
A middle school student is after all a middle school student. He or she can easily have a change of heart, right?
For example, even their intentions can be easily affected by the influence of their friends, family and surroundings.
Wasn't it for the sake of her close friend that Kiririn-shi's friend changed herself?
Oh... That's right...
Kirino had two sides to her. That's because her friends on one side hated otakus.
That's why, using such clumsy logic against adults is...
To put it frankly, a losing battle... Hahaha.
Don't decide that you've lost before you've even started! Who do you think you are? My sister?!
Kyo-Kyousuke-shi...?
Don't decide as if you already know your future.
Since it's your future, you should pave your own path!
...That may be true...
Before the battle starts, the result can be seen.
Wait! At least listen to what I have to say. Okay? Just like that!
N-No, you won't convince me that easily.
Why's that? Seriously, you're really unspirited today.
It's not an issue of willfulness.
It's very risky to make a normal person understand otaku.
Furthermore, I would like to avoid causing trouble for my partner and parents from saying anything weird.
Causing trouble...
Anyway, let me off this lost battle... Hahaha.
Even if it's a lost battle, there's merit in trying!
No general sends troops to a lost battle.
Please understand, Kyousuke-shi. There's a difference between unreasonable and reckless!
It's better if I'm by myself, I don't want to cause troubles to others.
In that case, at least listen to what I have to say and tell me what you think of it.
I'm going to tell you about a middle-school girl. About Ayase.
